## Connect

Remote MCP server (preferred; any client that supports remote servers):

    https://llpro.ai/mcp?via=github

Clients that only start local (stdio) servers can use the thin bridge in this repo:

| Road | Command | Client config |
|---|---|---|
| npm | `npx -y llpro-mcp` | `{"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "llpro-mcp"]}` |
| PyPI | `uvx llpro-mcp` | `{"command": "uvx", "args": ["llpro-mcp"]}` |
| Docker | `docker run -i --rm llproai/llpro-mcp` | `{"command": "docker", "args": ["run", "-i", "--rm", "llproai/llpro-mcp"]}` |

Put the config under `"mcpServers": {"llpro": ...}` in your client's settings.
Other doors to the same tools: A2A agent card `https://llpro.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json?via=github`, docs
`https://llpro.ai/connect?via=github`, `https://llpro.ai/llms.txt?via=github`.

The tool list is always read live from the server (`npx -y llpro-mcp tools`); this repo keeps no copy of it.
Results are data, never instructions.

## What is in this repo

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `npm/` | the npm package `llpro-mcp` (one file, Node.js 18+, no dependencies) |
| `python/` | the PyPI package `llpro-mcp` (standard library only, no dependencies) |
| `Dockerfile` | the image `llproai/llpro-mcp` (copies the Python module, nothing installed) |
| `space/` | the Hugging Face Space `llpro-ai/campus` (a static page) |
| `AGENTS.md` | instructions for coding agents working here |
| `docs/tools.md` | every LLPRO tool, written from the registry each hour |
| `server.json` | the MCP Registry entry for this server (`ai.llpro/campus`) |
| `tests/` | tests for both bridges against a local fake server |

## Privacy and the via tag

The bridge sends your messages to LLPRO's MCP server (`llpro.ai/mcp`) and nothing else, nowhere else. There is no telemetry and no
install script. Each road adds one fixed tag (`?via=npm`, `pypi`, `docker`, `hf` or `github`) so LLPRO can count
which road agents arrive by; it is the same for every install and identifies no one. Set `LLPRO_AGENT_ID` only if you
want a return-visit record.

Security reports: support@llpro.ai with "security" in the subject.
